title: the gate's verdict
description: role-settings.yaml's gate.output (json_schema), mapped onto Codex's --output-schema. Structured Outputs requires every key in properties to appear in required (optional fields allow null).

why.description: What was weighed, and what decided it. A paraphrase of the verdict is not accepted

evidence.description: The commands actually run and their real output, failures included. Required for an admit

standard.description: The standard applied (the SPEC's MUSTs, the seam contract, the machine bar)

alternatives.description: The options not taken, and why

risk.description: A hole knowingly left open. Where there is none, say so explicitly

out_of_scope.description: A defect found outside the MUSTs' scope. Do not make it grounds for a reject; return it as "recommended as its own Issue"

findings.description: Each finding, separately. The id is what a response and the next round point at, so a finding that is not listed here cannot be answered or tracked — put every blocking observation in, not a prose summary of them.

id.description: Stable within this Issue, e.g. GATE-001. A response cites it.

claim.description: What is wrong, specifically enough to be checked by someone else.

evidence.description: The command and output, or the file and line, that establishes it.

blocks_admission.description: Whether this alone withholds the verdict. False means it was worth saying but is not why the work is held.

prior_finding.description: The id of the earlier finding this re-raises, or null if new. Re-raising one unchanged does not warrant another round — state what changed.
